name: Image
summary: A framed image with rounded corners, a hover preview mask, a loading placeholder and a broken-src fallback.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-image> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `src`/`alt` set the picture, `width`/`height` the frame, `radius` the corner. On hover the image scales while a mask fades in — both animate on a persistent node via the shared motion tokens — and a click opens a zoom preview. Turn the zoom off with `preview="false"` (a plain framed picture); show a shimmer skeleton with `placeholder`; a broken/empty `src` swaps to a `fallback` glyph + label. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: The hover scale + mask fade live on a persistent node (only the :hover pseudo-class changes, never a subtree rebuild), so the transition always fires. Clicking (or Enter/Space on) the frame opens a modal preview overlay — a persistent node faded/scaled in on the shared tokens, never rebuilt on open. The load/error lifecycle toggles data-state on the persistent frame (loading→loaded→error) so the placeholder fades and the fallback reveals without a rebuild. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Image
spec.value: object-fit cover · scale 1.06 on hover, motion-slow ease-out

spec.label: Preview
spec.value: click/Enter opens a modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal); Esc / close button / backdrop dismiss; focus moves in and is restored on close. preview="false" → plain picture, no mask/click/dialog

spec.label: Placeholder
spec.value: shimmer skeleton (icon-muted on bg-secondary) shown while loading; fades on the image load, persistent node

spec.label: Fallback
spec.value: broken/empty src → system-image-square glyph + label, text-tertiary on bg-secondary, role=img

props.desc: Click-to-zoom modal. `false` → a plain framed picture (no mask, no click, no dialog)

props.desc: Frame corner from the DS radius scale

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Show a shimmer loading skeleton until the image loads

props.name: fallback
props.desc: Label shown in the broken-src error state (its presence never forces the state — a broken/empty src does)

props.name: (default slot)
props.desc: The label shown in the hover mask

whenToUse.when: a framed picture that invites a click to preview (a deck cover, an upload)
a picture is one part of a larger grouped surface

opinion.note: Always set alt for accessibility. Keep the mask label short — 'Preview', 'View' — it is an invitation, not a caption.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated against the DS V3 Image component-set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): it is width-driven with auto aspect ratio, fillable with a custom image OR a placeholder image style, and pairs with the Skeleton component for loading. That maps to antd's Image matrix — preview toggle, loading placeholder, broken-src fallback, width/height, shape/radius — all now supported. DS V3's measured cell set carries no per-state px for Image, so the styling derives from the token layer (radius scale, bg-container-secondary, bg-overlay, text-inverse, text-tertiary, icon-muted) + antd conventions. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
